Trump signs Greenland security deal at the UN
subhead: Under the wide-ranging 10-page pact, the United States will build two military bases in southern and eastern Greenland. It also blocks non-NATO, non-EU countries from strategic sectors in Greenland, in an attempt to bar US adversaries, China and Russia, from gaining a foothold in the Arctic.

title: US-UK 'special relationship' is tested by Trump as Burnham visits

title: 'Politicians know rising gas prices can cost them votes'
subhead: The increase in fuel prices generates public anger and poses a dilemma for authorities, who must decide whether to implement support measures. Economic choices, Le Monde columnist Isabelle Chaperon notes, often hinge on upcoming elections.

title: The Catholic Church's new power players: Americans
subhead: They hold key positions at the Holy See and are establishing think tanks, foundations and universities in Rome. In the wake of their compatriot Robert Prevost, who became Pope Leo XIV in 2025 and whose popularity continues to grow in the United States, American Catholics are throwing their full weight into shaping Catholicism.
